units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 6:13">Tosef. Bekh. VI, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 8a:8">Kidd. 8ᵃ</cite> (Ar. <cite ref="P00085"><he>עִגּוּל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:12">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00445"><he>יָנַק</he></cite>; a. fr.—Esp. <he>הע׳</he> the golden calf which the Israelites made in the desert.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:17">Tosef. Sabb. I, 17</cite> <he>אותו … שעשוי בו הע׳</he> that day was as ominous to Israel as the day whereon they made the golden calf; <cite ref="Shabbat 17a">Sabb. 17ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Sotah 14a:10">Sot. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>שכיפר על מעשה הע׳</he> he made atonement for the sin of the golden calf; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:3">Tosef. Neg. VI, 3</cite> <he>בית הע׳</he> Var., v. <cite ref="P00497"><he>עִיגּוּל</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>עֲגָלִים</he>.
Snh. 63ᵇ; a. fr.—[Ab. d’R. N. ch. VI, end מביאין הע׳, read: העִגּוּלִים, v. עִיגּוּל.]—Fem. עֶגְלָה heifer.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 7:2">Sot. VII, 2</cite> <he>פרשת ע׳ ערופה</he> the verses to be read at the ceremony of breaking the heifer’s neck (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:7">Deut. XXI, 7</cite> sq.). Ib. IX, 7 (47ᵇ) <he>אם נערפה הע׳ וכ׳</he> if the murderer was found after the heifer’s neck was broken.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>הראה לו … ע׳ ערופה</he> the Lord showed Abraham the ceremony of &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 45a:8">Sot. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>מדידת ע׳</he> the measuring which is done for the ceremony of &c. (to ascertain the nearest town).
Par. I, 1 ע׳ בת שנתה וכ׳ heifer (mentioned in the Law) means one not yet one year old, and cow means one two years old; a. fr.
